pr_title: fix(router): update type for routerLink to include null and undefined
pr_body:
PR #13380 added support for `null` and `undefined` but the type on the parameter was not updated. This would result in a compilation error if `fullTemplateTypeCheck` is enabled.

Fixes #36544

issue_context.title: routerLink type doesn't support null | undefined
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package @angular/router ### Is this a regression? Yes, this code works with strictTemplates disabled. ### Description The router link directive test the value with != null, and handles null & undefined as an empty relative route. We use this when we want to change the fragment of the URL and stay on the same page. ```A Link``` This can be worked around by using: ```A Link``` But the code does support null and undefined, it's just the type that doesn't. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/james-schwartzkopf/ng9-issues/tree/routerLink-undefined ## 🔥 Exception or Error ``` ERROR in src/app/app.component.html:1:4 - error TS2322: Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string | any[]'. 1 A Link ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ src/app/app.component.ts:5:16 5 templateUrl: './app.component.html', ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Error occurs in the template of component AppComponent. ``` ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:**
